question: Does K3 outperform K1 on ordinary generated terminal-only answers when the question, prior weights and data match and no intermediate output is requested?
protocol: Uniform eight-node deterministic successor maps. Fresh disjoint map-level splits; one randomized order per map. Identical document references and explicit three-hop question for both arms. Train each with response-only full-vocabulary CE on the digit and turn termination, including leading space under the pinned tokenizer. Fresh AdamW each. No gold intermediate labels or tokens. Greedy batch-one generation, stop at end or first complete line. Require one visible digit 0-7 and valid termination.
gate: Advance only for >=5 absolute points K3 minus K1 complete exact accuracy and at most two lost third-hop categorical cases vs shared parent on the fixed 96-map retention suite. Report paired discordance and bootstrap interval, full V3 K1/K3 NLL, train time, tokens and actual request latency.
session: next explicitly authorized execution session; registered after trace, attribution and functional zero-shot results
